content: The IocSendGroup / IocWriteGroup function shall be wrapped with the memory allocation keywords mechanism 1 #define OS_<IE>_START_SEC_CODE 2 #include "Os_MemMap.h" 3 4 <IocSendGroup, IocWriteGroup> 5 6 #define OS_<IE>_STOP_SEC_CODE 7 #include "Os_MemMap.h" where <IE> is the shortName of the sending OsApplication configured in OsIoc- SendingOsApplicationRef of the respective OsIocCommunication channel.
